sources_considered.why: Read in full. It concerns self-reported critical thinking with generative AI broadly, not representative careful-checking rates among OpenAI Deep Research users.
Read relevant abstract, methods, and conclusion passages. Associations between confidence and critical thinking do not establish the product-specific behavioral forecast or its proposed cause.
Read participant-method passages. Paid, instructed expert verification cannot estimate how often ordinary users voluntarily check reports.
Read user-evaluation passages. Comparisons of interaction quality do not establish the prevalence or cause of careful fact-checking.

unresolved_gaps: No representative measurement of careful fact-checking by OpenAI Deep Research users was located.
No direct causal test was located showing that superficially credible presentation explains low checking rates.
